name: Jane Doe
source:
Cold routine turns to a warmer disorder when Lucan meets Ren, a strange wolf who sparks life in Lucan’s life. What starts as simple conversations slowly shift into something much harder to walk away from. As days blur, Lucan is left questioning what’s genuine. 

[From [url=https://wolfururu.itch.io/janedoe]Itch.io[/url]]
